name: Mesh
description: Loads file-based GLB / glTF models through the renderer adapter. The system calls `loadMesh` (or, for pools of identical animated characters, a deduped `loadModelTemplate` + per-entity `instantiateModel`) and emits `mesh.loading`, `mesh.loaded` (carrying the meshId + discovered animation clip names), or `mesh.error`. Optionally each frame it makes the loaded mesh follow a sibling MeshPrimitive proxy's XZ position and yaw toward its movement or aim direction. Listens for `mesh.load` to (re)trigger a load.
